privacy.title: Privacy
privacy.no_tracking.title: No permanent visitor storage
privacy.no_tracking.text: For the access gate, your public IP address is processed briefly, immediately replaced on the physical hardware in Germany with a non-reversible check value that changes on every server restart, and kept only in memory. The operator keeps no IP logs and performs no audience analytics or profiling.
privacy.plan_requests.title: Retrieving the plan
privacy.plan_requests.text: The sanitised plan is retrieved once from the origin server when the page is opened. While the page remains open, the browser refreshes this view no more than every five minutes between 06:00 and 22:00 (Europe/Berlin); there are no automatic plan requests at night. Your local class and course selection, custom subject names and filters are not transmitted. The encrypted connection runs through the relay server in Sweden to the physical hardware in Germany.
privacy.local.title: Local settings
privacy.local.text: The correct answer to the access question, your selected class, courses, custom subject and teacher names, appearance, filters, language choice, confirmation of the usage notice and the fact that the transparency notice was shown are stored only in your browser's local storage. The answer is sent to the origin server again only when the session must be restored; the other local settings and confirmations are not sent to the server. ‘Reset access’ deletes the stored answer. The transparency notice appears again if local browser storage is cleared.
privacy.redaction.title: Anonymising the source plan
privacy.redaction.text: Teacher data from structured API fields and clearly recognised text references is processed on the private server solely to remove it from entries and comments. The operator may additionally import a local list of names for this purpose; the service only reads the source file and does not copy it. IDs and the raw API response are not stored. The private redaction list is deleted at the start of each school year, is never sent to the browser and is not linked to visitor data.
privacy.feedback.title: Voluntary error reports
privacy.feedback.text: When you use ‘Report an error’, only the message text and submission time are stored on the origin server. The message is not linked to an IP address, browser identifier, class or local settings and is automatically deleted after 180 days by an hourly cleanup. An anonymous minute-based aggregate counter limits abuse and is removed within one day. Do not enter personal information.
privacy.infrastructure.title: Hosting and encrypted connection
privacy.infrastructure.text: The publicly accessible relay server is operated by Privex Inc. in Sweden. It forwards requests to the operator's physical hardware in Germany. For technical reasons, Privex receives your IP address and encrypted connection data in particular. Cloudflare is no longer involved in transmitting content and therefore cannot decrypt the contents of your connection.
privacy.infrastructure.encryption: The connection is encrypted with TLS. Native Encrypted Client Hello is enabled and, in supporting browsers, additionally protects the requested domain name from intermediary networks. Post-quantum encryption is not yet active.
privacy.infrastructure.transfer: According to Privex, Privex Inc. is registered in Belize. Although the relay server is located in Sweden, access or processing outside the European Economic Area therefore cannot be ruled out completely.
privacy.github.title: External GitHub link
privacy.github.text: GitHub content is not embedded in this website. Only when you select the source code link does your browser connect directly to GitHub and leave this website. GitHub then processes technically necessary connection data under its own privacy terms.
privacy.rights.title: Legal basis and rights
privacy.rights.text: Where personal data is processed for secure operation, this is based on the legitimate interest in security and availability under Article 6(1)(f) GDPR. Your statutory rights include access, rectification, erasure, restriction, objection and the right to lodge a complaint with a data protection authority.
privacy.more: The site operator and contact details are available through the ‘Site operator’ button. Further details are provided in the VPlan privacy notice.
legal.privacy_heading: Privacy notice for the substitution plan
legal.imprint_heading: Legal notice for the substitution plan
legal.privacy_contact: To exercise your rights or request early deletion of a voluntary report, contact the site operator. Without contact details or a user identifier, an individual anonymous report may not be identifiable with certainty.
legal.disclaimer_text: Only the school's official substitution plan is authoritative. Despite careful preparation, no guarantee is given for accuracy, completeness or timeliness.

changelog.title: Changelog
changelog.intro: The most important changes to the substitution plan, summarised directly from the Git history.
changelog.quality.title: Improved reliability and app installation
changelog.quality.item_1: Android and other browsers now always receive the current app manifest.
changelog.quality.item_2: Privacy, synchronisation, local storage and error reports are now more robust.
changelog.quality.item_3: The class selector is now limited to the classes A to C that actually exist.
changelog.quality.item_4: The interface can now be translated, and languages can be switched directly in the header using flags.
changelog.quality.item_5: From 3 p.m., the next available plan day opens automatically; all days remain available for manual selection.
changelog.quality.item_6: Dark mode is the default again, and the selected appearance is now stored reliably.
changelog.names.title: Better protection for teacher names
changelog.names.text: Written-out names from the data source are detected automatically and removed before public output.
changelog.colors.title: Vibrant subject colours added
changelog.colors.text: Subjects and courses can be highlighted locally using high-contrast accent colours.
disclaimer.title: Important notice before use
disclaimer.private: This website is a purely private student project intended only to present information more clearly for personal use.
disclaimer.unofficial.title: Not an official service:
disclaimer.unofficial.text: This private service is not an official school view. The data is processed automatically; only the official substitution plan is authoritative.
disclaimer.warranty.title: No warranty:
disclaimer.warranty.text: No guarantee is given for the accuracy, completeness or timeliness of any information. Synchronisation may be delayed or contain errors.
disclaimer.binding.title: Authoritative information:
disclaimer.binding.text: Only the school's official substitution plan is authoritative. No liability is accepted for missed lessons, cancellations or absences.
disclaimer.privacy.title: Privacy:
disclaimer.privacy.text: For the access gate, your public IP address is processed briefly and retained on the physical hardware in Germany only as a random check value in memory until the next server restart. The correct answer to the access question is stored locally on your device and sent again for verification when no session exists. The sanitised plan is retrieved through the Privex relay in Sweden when the page is opened and no more than every five minutes during the day; other local settings are not transmitted. Confirmations that this notice and the one-time transparency notice were shown also remain only in the browser. Teacher data and an optional private list of names are processed on the origin server solely for redaction and deleted at the start of each school year. Your class, courses, custom subject and teacher names, appearance and language settings remain on your device. Voluntary error reports are stored separately. Cloudflare is no longer involved in transmitting content.
disclaimer.confirm: I understand that this is an unofficial view and use the site at my own responsibility.
transparency.title: Transparenzhinweis:
transparency.architecture: Die Serverarchitektur wurde massiv geändert und der Server für den Vertretungsplan steht nun in Schweden (Privex.io). Die Datenschutzerklärung wurde diesbezüglich aktualisiert. Damit ist der Vertretungsplan nun unabhängig von US-Unternehmen und Cloudflare kann den Inhalt deiner Daten nicht mehr mitlesen. Dazu wurde jetzt natives Encrypted Client Hello hinzugefügt, um deine Privatsphäre zu schützen. Post Quantum Verschlüsselung um deine Verbindung gegen zukünftige Supercomputer zu schützen wird auch noch hinzugefügt.
transparency.relay: Bitte beachte, dass der Server in Schweden nur als Relay fungiert. Die eigentliche physische Hardware steht weiterhin in Deutschland.

gate.title: Short security question
gate.intro: Answer the question before the substitution plan is loaded.
gate.question: Which room is the Old Assembly Hall in?
gate.error.invalid: Unfortunately, that answer is not correct.
gate.error.blocked: After three incorrect answers, this internet connection is blocked until the next server restart.
gate.error.service: The access gate is currently unavailable. Please try again later.
gate.privacy: After successful verification, your answer is stored locally in this browser and sent again only to restore access. To limit attempts, the server keeps only a non-reversible check value in memory.
sync.stale: The latest refresh failed. The most recent successfully loaded version is shown.
legal.access_text: Failed attempts and access grants are processed as random check values in memory only until the server restarts. After a correct answer, a technically necessary session cookie containing a random identifier is set; JavaScript cannot read it and it is removed when the browser session closes. The browser also stores the correct answer locally and sends it to the origin server again when a session must be restored. A rejected stored answer and ‘Reset access’ both delete it. Three incorrect answers block the same internet connection. Multiple people sharing the same public IP address may therefore be affected together.
